share.said:
You lend notes (port 51013) to everyone in your groups, as many at once as want it. To let fewer in at once, change it on your home page, or `svrngs share 51013 --limit <number>`.
svrngs is running here already, so they can open it now.
`svrngs unshare notes` stops lending it.
